title: The people ask for guidance and receive the Lord's answer
description: The remaining people in Judah, led by Johanan, ask the prophet Jeremiah to inquire of God whether they should go to Egypt or stay in the land, promising to obey the answer. After ten days, the word of the Lord comes: If they remain in the land, God will build them up and protect them from the king of Babylon, but if they go to Egypt, sword, famine, and plague will strike them there.
